title: Sheet and Drawing Numbering Profiles
resolver_rule: Select the highest-precedence applicable numbering profile. Lower-precedence profiles may supply only unresolved definitions permitted by the higher authority; they shall not silently replace or contradict it.

profiles.name: Governed CDE / Document-Control Numbering
profiles.selection: Use when the project has an authority-, client-, contract-, EIR-, project-information-standard-, or CDE-governed document numbering convention.
requirements: Resolve the governing document-number grammar before first formal registration.
Preserve semantic classification separately from the generated document number.
Treat CDE platform configuration as implementation evidence, not as authority unless the governing project arrangement explicitly makes it authoritative.
Validate project stage, work condition, spatial metadata, discipline, information form, content classification, sequence, status/suitability, revision, and title as required by the selected profile.
After first formal registration or issue, identity changes require governed document-control change rather than casual authoring-tool renumbering.

profiles.name: Qatar / Ashghal Drawing Identity
rules: The drawing identity follows the applicable Ashghal/project requirement; TIVERIT shall not substitute a simplified sheet-number syntax.
Project stage is governed metadata and is not assumed to be an identity field unless the applicable project requirement says so.
The final number/sequence shall follow the applicable Ashghal/project rule; TIVERIT shall not invent content-series meanings where the authority material is silent.
Where implemented in Aconex or another CDE, the authority requirement remains upstream of platform configuration.

profiles.name: UAE / Miral Project Numbering
profiles.selection: Do not activate a document-number grammar from country or client name alone. Activate only when the governing Miral/project document-control, EIR/project-information-standard, approved BEP, or contractual Aconex configuration defines the required identity fields and codes.

confirmed: For the Warner Bros. World Abu Dhabi Expansion project reviewed in 2026, Aconex is the contractual CDE while BIM 360/ACC is used for collaboration/markups; the detailed interface was recorded as still to be concluded with the GC after award.

The project BEP describes the Harry Potter Expansion as phases 2A and 2B; project phase is therefore a real project classification dimension and shall not be inferred from document status or work condition.
The Miral LOIN framework uses RIBA Stage 2 through Stage 6 with LOD progression; stage/LOD is governed project information but is not evidence that stage belongs inside the document number.
The project has granular zone/sub-zone naming and discipline structures; these may supply semantic classification only where the governing project source explicitly defines them.
Some naming matters remained disputed/open in the BEP comments process, so a tracker status of closed is insufficient evidence by itself for canonical numbering rules.
not_yet_confirmed: A canonical Miral enterprise sheet/drawing number field order.
A canonical WBX Aconex document-number grammar for drawings.
Whether project phase 2A/2B or RIBA stage is encoded in the document number versus metadata only.
Canonical sheet-content numeric ranges for plans, enlarged plans, RCPs, details, schedules, perspectives, or other drawing subtypes.
A stable project-wide code set for every WBX zone/sub-zone and discipline suitable for publication as a reusable Miral profile.

rules: Do not generalize a project-specific Miral convention into a UAE national convention.
Do not infer field order, codes, content ranges, project stage encoding, or Aconex metadata from memory, historical project practice, or job title.
Treat Aconex as the contractual CDE implementation for the evidenced WBX project, not as the upstream authority that defines Miral's requirements.

Preserve project phase/stage, work condition, zone/sub-zone, discipline, content class/subtype, status/suitability, revision, and title as separate semantic dimensions until governing evidence explicitly maps them into identity fields.
If the document-number grammar remains unresolved, the pre-registration gate returns unresolved and blocks generation of a supposedly compliant Miral/Aconex number.
Once additional governing evidence is curated, map it to the common semantic classification rather than redefining semantic classes.

profiles.name: Simplified Non-CDE Sheet Numbering
profiles.selection: Use only where no higher-precedence authority, client, project, or governed CDE numbering requirement applies.
rules: Use the common semantic classification registry.
A compact TIVERIT numbering syntax may be selected only after higher-precedence requirements have been checked and found silent or inapplicable.
Legacy D-18/D-19 style discipline/series/sequence concepts may be considered for this fallback profile only after the content taxonomy research is complete; they are not universal defaults.

suspended_decisions.reason: Research established that international, authority, client, project-information-standard, BEP, and CDE requirements must resolve first. A TIVERIT discipline/series/sequence convention may survive only as a lower-precedence simplified fallback profile.
